name: Social proofs
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site social proof block, matched to the live ahaslides.com: Badges, the award row from the footer of the word cloud slide type page. It renders from a data file, so a yearly badge refresh is a data edit. The G2 rating row lives in the Header page as the G2 reviews row. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: One block: Badges, four award badges in a row (G2 Best Software 2026 and the Training Magazine Network Choice Awards 2026), 80px wide with a 12px gap, each linking to the AhaSlides reviews on G2 or its winners page, with the live title, aria-label and alt text
Badge images are unaltered third-party marks: never recolour, crop or restyle them
The list comes from marketing/data/social-proofs-badges.json, not hand-typed markup
The G2 rating row is the G2 reviews row on the Header page, on by default
layoutsIntro: The social proof row copied from the live ahaslides.com. Class names carry the block.
